name: ENGL 3123W
title: British Literature from 1890 to the Mid-Twentieth Century
description: British literature from the late Victorian to the immediate post-World War II period. Works by writers such as Conrad, Lawrence, Mansfield, Forster, Woolf, and Eliot.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011. Not open to students who have completed ENGL 3119.
